$comment: What each bridge read prints, for the host-governed fetch agent (vc-test P1d-3b). An answer is that output: the same JSON, or the text for a text command. role names the governance.servers entry that serves it. A binary command cannot travel as JSON text and is answered missing.

jira get.expect: the issue JSON as GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key}?fields=…&expand=renderedFields returns it: key, id, fields{…}, renderedFields{…}

jira comments.expect: { total, comments: [Jira comment objects: id, created, updated, body (ADF)], truncated } — all comments oldest first; with --newest the newest --max, newest first; with --rendered each also has renderedBody (HTML)

jira request.expect: the JSON Jira returns for that --method and --path: the field list [{ id, name, custom }], the remote links [{ object: { url, title } }], or a JQL search { issues: [{ key, fields }] } — the first maxResults issues of the body's jql in its ORDER BY, one page, not every page

jira dev-prs.expect: { issueId, urls: [pull request URLs from the issue's development panel] }

jira confluence-page.expect: the page JSON as GET /wiki/api/v2/pages/{id}?body-format=storage returns it: id, title, body.storage.value

ado get-workitem.expect: the work item as GET _apis/wit/workitems/{id}?$expand=all returns it: id, fields{System.Title, System.State, …}, relations[{ rel, url, attributes }]

ado comments.expect: { total, comments: [Azure work-item comments: id, text (HTML), createdDate, modifiedDate], truncated } — oldest first; with --newest the newest --max, newest first

ado wiql.expect: the WIQL query's result in its ORDER BY: with --fields { count, items: [{ id, <field ref>: value }] }; without { count, ids: [id] }

ado get-pr.expect: the pull request as GET _apis/git/pullrequests/{id} returns it: status, title, description, creationDate, closedDate, sourceRefName, targetRefName, lastMergeSourceCommit.commitId, repository{ id, name, project{ name } }

ado pr-changes.expect: { changeEntries: [{ item: { path }, changeType, sourceServerItem }], truncated } — that iteration's changes against the merge base

ado pr-threads.expect: { value: [threads: id, status, isDeleted, threadContext{ filePath, rightFileStart{ line } }, comments[{ content, commentType, publishedDate, isDeleted }]] }

ado get-file.expect: the file's content at that commit, as text (not JSON)

gh.expect: { data: { repository: { pullRequest: { reviewThreads: { nodes: [{ isResolved }] } } } } } — the pinned review-thread query's answer
the unified diff, as text (not JSON): of the pull request, or of the compare range {from}...{to} the path names

{ items: [issues and pull requests: number, title, state, created_at, html_url, repository_url (https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo} — the PR's repository is read from it), pull_request] } — GitHub search results
{ items: [commits: sha, repository{ full_name }] } — GitHub commit search results
[pull requests associated with the commit: number, …]
[changed files: filename, status, additions, deletions, patch] — that one page
[review comments: path, line, original_line, body, created_at]
the compare JSON for {from}...{to}: status (ahead | behind | identical | diverged), ahead_by, behind_by
the pull request JSON: title, state, merged_at, created_at, head{ sha }, base{ ref }, body
